desc:
🥚 Build For Eggs

🥚 Steal Eggs before the Giant gets you!  
🏡 Bring them back to your plot and hatch them!  
🤯 Discover crazy, rare things hiding inside your Eggs!  
💰 Earn cash from your collection and upgrade your Building!  
☁️ Build higher and higher to reach new clouds with even better Eggs!  
🏆 Collect them all and build to the TOP!

✨ Can you hatch the RAREST one?

👍 Like, Favourite & Follow if you enjoy the game!
